title: Range Frequency Queries
goal: Answer how often a value appears within each inclusive array range.
strategy: Store sorted occurrence indices for every value. Two binary searches isolate the occurrence positions between left and right; their index difference is the frequency.

phasePurposes.start: Answer how often a value appears within each inclusive array range.
phasePurposes.inspect: Store sorted occurrence indices for every value. Two binary searches isolate the occurrence positions between left and right; their index difference is the frequency.
phasePurposes.update: Store sorted occurrence indices for every value. Two binary searches isolate the occurrence positions between left and right; their index difference is the frequency.
phasePurposes.done: Answer how often a value appears within each inclusive array range.

edgeCases: An absent value has an empty position list
Equal inclusive endpoints inspect one position
All values equal create a dense occurrence list
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
